reviewed_by: Blind judgment Reviewer (subagent, 0 tool uses, samples inline), batch fix-loop-tick-2 2026-08-20

competency_fulfillment.rationale: All four named figures appear and the factual content is correct: seed 45 'an exact location in space with no length or width' (point), seed 43 endpoints of a line segment (2), seed 603 'no endpoints and extends forever in both directions' (line), seed 44 flashlight beam (ray). But the competency carries two verbs, 'recognize, using models' and 'draws', and the set is dominated by verbal definition recall. Exactly one item (seed 605) puts a model in front of the pupil.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: 14 items but only 11 unique stems (seeds 500/501/502 duplicate 44/45/46 with options reordered). Against those 11: point 1 item (seed 45, pure definition recall), line 3, line segment 3, ray 4. 'Recognize, using models' is exercised at 1/11 -- only seed 605's model. 'Draws' is exercised at 0/11 directly and 4/11 as procedural questions about drawing. A competency whose explicit modality clause reaches under 10% of items, and whose first-named figure gets a single definitional item, is short of the competency's full scope.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Most stems are correctly pitched and counts are 0-3 with a 0-10 cm ruler. Three push past it: seed 602's 'set square only' uses an undefined tool plus a meta-qualifier Grade 3 does not parse as a truth condition; seed 604 offers 'infinite' while every other item says 'forever', an inconsistent register and a likely dead option; seed 45's 'exact location in space with no length or width' is the most abstract sentence in the set and carries the entire coverage of 'point'.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Roughly seven templates exist (symbol convention, endpoint count, real-world model to name, definition to name, ruler procedure, tool selection, figure to name). Against that, 3 of 14 items are exact stem duplicates and the endpoint-count template alone accounts for 3 of 11 unique stems in identical phrasing. Every item is 4-option MCQ; there is no construction or figure-production response type anywhere.

competency_alignment.rationale: Nothing reaches into later geometry -- no angles, no parallel/perpendicular, no lettered-point notation. Two items reach sideways: seeds 46/502 require reading a centimetre ruler, a measurement skill imported into a Q1 geometry competency; seed 602's 'set square' introduces a drafting instrument the competency does not name. The larger alignment problem is the shortfall above: the competency names 'recognize, using models' and 'draws', and the set delivers mostly naming from a verbal definition.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Every magnitude is small and concrete: endpoint counts of 0-3, a 4 cm segment on a 0-10 cm ruler. Contexts (flashlight beam, paper, ruler) are familiar to Grade 3.

problems_reported: Duplicates (3): seed 500 = seed 44, seed 501 = seed 45, seed 502 = seed 46 -- identical stems, options reordered only. 14 items, 11 unique.

seed 602, option 'set square only': a set square has a straight edge and is a legitimate tool for drawing a straight line segment, so the option is substantially true of the key; only the appended 'only' makes it wrong, a logical hedge Grade 3 cannot be expected to resolve. It is also the sole multi-word qualified option among three bare nouns, an odd-one-out formatting cue.

seed 42 vs seed 604, terminology conflict: 42 asks what symbols go 'at both ends' of a line while 604 keys that a line has 0 endpoints. Both correct as written, but the set should say 'at both ends of the drawn part'.

seed 605, answer given away in the stem: the parenthetical '(starts at endpoint A and extends past B with an arrowhead)' restates the definition of a ray, converting the set's only genuine model-recognition item into a reading item.
seed 604, dead distractor 'infinite' clashes with the 'forever' wording used elsewhere and is likely above Grade 3 Q1 reading.
seeds 46/502, unverified prerequisite: reading a cm ruler is a measurement skill not confirmed available at this node.
No wrong or ambiguous keys found beyond the seed 602 caveat; no mathematically false statement.
